newsitem.title: USA: U.S. crudes continue higher, sweet grades retreat.
newsitem.headline: U.S. crudes continue higher, sweet grades retreat.

text.p: U.S. crudes found additional strength Tuesday afternoon on technical buying in the paper markets, pushing outright June West Texas Intermediate/Cushing to new highs this session.
Meanwhile, domestic grade barrels were mixed, with sweet crudes retreating from earlier prices and sour crudes moving closer to the outright benchmark.
Traders said the market seemed to be overdone, resulting in the pullback for Light Louisiana Sweet/St. James barrels.
"It looked overvalued with Brent on offer to the U.S. Gulf at 80 cents under June WTI," said a crude trader in Texas.
